Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-off cruise control - Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now with hands-off cruise control simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles with minimal steering input from you. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-off cruise control.

Driver assistance and safety technology are thoroughly integrated throughout this model. Adaptive cruise control, traffic jam assist, and active lane keeping work together to support confident driving. The top view camera system and park assist with front and rear acoustic sensors simplify maneuvering, while comprehensive airbag protection and structural safety systems provide peace of mind.

This one-owner vehicle comes backed by a clean Carfax history. The All-Weather Floor Mats and Cargo Mat included through the Audi Guard Protection Kit help maintain the vehicle's interior condition. With just over 21,000 miles, this A5 Sportback remains well within the early stages of its service life.

We invite you to experience this 2023 Audi A5 Sportback at your earliest convenience. Our team is ready to answer your questions and arrange a test drive that demonstrates the quality and capability this vehicle delivers.

Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. This 2023 Audi A5 Sportback 45 S line Premium Plus quattro combines athletic design with refined engineering, offering a vehicle that performs as beautifully as it looks.

- Bang & Olufsen Sound System w/3D Sound
- Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus
- Adaptive Cruise Control with Traffic Jam Assist
- Audi Advanced Key with keyless entry
- Top View Camera System and Parking System Plus
- Audi Active Lane Assist and Audi Side Assist w/Pre Sense Rear
- Heated Steering Wheel and Driver Seat Memory
- Power Folding Exterior Mirrors with Auto-Dimming
- Black Optic Plus Package with 19 Bi-Color Wheels
- SiriusXM with 360L and 3-month Platinum trial
- Heated Front Sport Seats with Leather/Dinamica surfaces
- Red Brake Calipers and Dark Chrome Exhaust Tips
- Brushed Aluminum and Stainless Steel accents throughout
- Audi Phone Box and 2 Rear USB Charge Ports

The A5 Sportback delivers a sophisticated driving experience with its 2.0L 4-Cylinder TFSI engine paired with a 7-Speed Automatic S tronic transmission and quattro all-wheel drive. The combination of 24 city and 32 highway MPG provides efficient performance without compromise, while the adaptive suspension and responsive steering create confidence on any road surface.

The Black Optic Plus Package presents a commanding presence with its glossy black Audi rings, darkened trim elements, and 19-inch bi-color wheels. Red brake calipers and dark chrome exhaust tips add purposeful styling accents, while the black exterior mirror housings and rear lip spoiler enhance the vehicles modern aesthetic.

Inside, the Premium Plus package surrounds you with technology and comfort. The Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus serves as your digital command center, while the Bang & Olufsen sound system with 3D Sound elevates every drive. Adaptive Cruise Control and Traffic Jam Assist work intelligently to reduce driver fatigue, and the Top View Camera System simplifies parking in tight spaces. Heated front sport seats with leather and Dinamica surfaces adjust to your exact preferences through driver seat memory.

The S line Interior Package refines every touchpoint with brushed aluminum inlays and stainless steel pedal caps, while the leatherette-covered center console and door armrests establish premium quality throughout the cabin. With genuine wood accents on the dashboard and door panels, every detail reflects Audis commitment to craftsmanship.

This A5 Sportback represents an opportunity to own a vehicle that integrates technology, performance, and luxury into a cohesive package. We invite you to visit our showroom, experience the commanding presence of this Mythos Black Metallic sedan firsthand, and discover why the A5 Sportback continues to define the compact luxury segment.

description:
Meet the 2024 Volkswagen Golf GTI SE, a precision-engineered sport compact that delivers engaging performance with practical everyday versatility.

- Harman/Kardon® Speakers with 9-speaker audio system
- MIB3 Discover Pro infotainment with 10" touchscreen navigation
- Panoramic power moonroof
- Adaptive suspension tuning
- Actively ventilated front seats with heating capability
- Heated steering wheel
- 19" multi-spoke gloss black alloy wheels
- Forward collision warning with autonomous emergency braking
- Lane departure warning system
- SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio
- Rear parking camera
- Electronic stability control
- All-wheel independent suspension with anti-roll bars
- Speed-sensing power steering
- Rain-sensing wipers with rear window wiper

The GTI SE combines a 2.0L TSI turbocharged engine with a 6-speed manual transmission to create a driving experience that responds precisely to driver input. City driving achieves 23 mpg while highway cruising delivers 34 mpg, offering respectable efficiency for a performance-focused vehicle. The front-wheel-drive platform with four-wheel independent suspension and electronic stability control creates predictable, confident handling characteristics that inspire confidence in various driving conditions.

Interior refinements elevate daily driving. Heated front sport seats with active ventilation maintain comfort through temperature extremes, while the heated steering wheel provides additional warmth during cold weather. The leather-wrapped sport steering wheel and leather shift knob reinforce the vehicle's performance identity. Dual-zone automatic temperature control, power windows, and remote keyless entry address practical convenience needs.

Technology integration focuses on driver engagement and safety. The 10-inch MIB3 Discover Pro touchscreen with integrated navigation simplifies route planning, while steering wheel-mounted audio controls keep attention focused on the road. Forward collision warning paired with autonomous emergency braking provides active protection, complemented by lane departure warning that alerts during unintended lane drift.

Safety systems throughout include dual front impact airbags, front and rear side airbags, and overhead curtain airbags creating a comprehensive protective envelope. Four-wheel disc brakes with brake assist and ABS provide confident stopping power. The security system with panic alarm and emergency communication through VW Car-Net Safe & Secure (5-year service included) provides additional peace of mind.

This 2024 Golf GTI SE presents an opportunity to own a sport compact that balances performance aspirations with practical daily-use requirements. With 8,626 miles, this example remains essentially new with the complete manufacturer support period ahead. We invite you to experience the driver-focused engineering that defines the GTI lineup.

description: RALLY-BRED, THRILLING, FACTORY FRESH, NO-ACCIDENT, ONE-OWNER, NONSMOKER, THE HOT HATCH THAT ACTUALLY DELIVERS! The 2024 Toyota GR Corolla continues to prove that Toyota, the brand that practically invented sensible transportation, can also build a genuinely thrilling hot hatch. This particular example, finished in Ice Cap, was ordered in the Premium grade, striking a genuine sweet spot in the GR Corolla lineup between the base Core and range-topping Circuit Edition. Standard GR-FOUR all-wheel drive gives this Corolla genuine rally-bred traction in any weather, backed by a driver-selectable torque split that lets the driver tailor the car's handling character to the moment. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The GR Corolla earned its reputation by delivering genuine rally-derived performance in a package that still works as everyday transportation, borrowing its turbocharged three-cylinder heart directly from the GR Yaris. Buyers cross-shopping the Honda Civic Type R and Volkswagen Golf R consistently point to the GR Corolla's raw, unfiltered character and genuinely engaging six-speed manual as reasons they choose Toyota over more refined but less visceral rivals. Every GR Corolla comes with a driver-adjustable AWD torque split between Front, Rear, and Track modes, giving owners genuine flexibility to tailor the car's handling to daily driving, foul weather, or a day at the track. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION Reviewers have consistently praised the GR Corolla for its genuinely satisfying six-speed manual transmission and its raw, unrefined character, frequently describing it as one of the more emotionally engaging hot hatches on sale, even when compared against more polished rivals like the Civic Type R. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 14,453-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage New Vehicle Limited Warranty Comprehensive coverage against defects in materials or workmanship across nearly every system. Rust Perforation Warranty Covers rust perforation of body sheet metal panels. Expires 02/21/2029, unlimited mileage. Extended service plans may also be available to provide additional peace of mind moving forward. STANDARD FEATURES The Premium grade brings genuine performance and comfort upgrades over the base Core trim: front and rear Torsen limited-slip differentials, previously only available via the Core's optional Performance Package, come standard, along with functional brake cooling ducts and red GR brake calipers. Brin Naub suede-trimmed sport seats with heating, a heated steering wheel, an 8-speaker JBL Premium audio system, and a wireless charging pad round out a trim level that adds genuine everyday comfort without diluting the GR Corolla's performance focus. MECHANICAL FEATURES This GR Corolla is powered by a turbocharged 1.6-liter three-cylinder engine, producing 300 horsepower and 273 lb-ft of torque through a genuinely rewarding six-speed manual transmission. It's an engine with real character, delivering a distinctive, raspy exhaust note and a turbocharger chirp on every shift that few rivals can match. The GR-FOUR all-wheel-drive system, backed by front and rear Torsen limited-slip differentials, puts that power down with genuine confidence, while the driver-selectable torque split lets the driver dial in the exact handling balance they want for any given drive. EXTERIOR FEATURES The GR Corolla's aggressive fender flares, functional hood vents, and purposeful stance give it a genuinely distinctive presence that stands apart from any other Corolla. Finished in Ice Cap, this GR Corolla carries a clean, purposeful look that lets its performance hardware do the talking. The gloss black grille and rear bumper cover, along with 18 inch wheels, round out an exterior that promises serious performance and delivers on it. INTERIOR FEATURES Step inside and the Brin Naub suede-trimmed sport seats with GR logos immediately signal this cabin's performance intent, complemented by heated front seats and a heated steering wheel for genuine everyday comfort. Aluminum sport pedals and a leather-wrapped shifter knob round out a cabin built for driver engagement. A 60/40-split rear bench keeps this GR Corolla genuinely practical for a dedicated performance hatchback, letting owners carry passengers or cargo as the day demands. INFOTAINMENT & TECHNOLOGY An 8 inch touchscreen anchors the cabin with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while a 12.3 inch digital gauge cluster adds GR-specific displays including AWD mode, turbo boost pressure, and a dedicated tachometer. A wireless charging pad keeps compatible phones powered without a cable in sight. The 8-speaker JBL Premium audio system rounds out the technology on board, delivering genuinely rich sound whether cruising or attacking a back road. SAFETY FEATURES This GR Corolla comes equipped with Toyota Safety Sense, including adaptive cruise control, lane departure alert, and pre-collision warning with pedestrian detection, all working together to reduce driver workload and add genuine peace of mind. Automatic high beams and front and rear parking sensors round out a safety suite that gives drivers real confidence, whether attacking a canyon road or navigating a crowded parking lot. ... and there's SO MUCH more! Manufacturer documentation accompanies this vehicle and will be reviewed with the purchaser. BUY WITH CONFIDENCE AS THE FACTORY WARRANTY IS STILL INTACT! - Bang & Olufsen Sound System with 3D Sound
- Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus
- Top View Camera System
- Wireless Phone Charging Pad
- Power Folding Exterior Mirrors with memory function

- Heated front sport seats with leather seating surfaces

This powertrain configuration ensures confident handling across varied driving conditions, from daily commutes to weekend excursions.

Step inside and discover an interior crafted with meticulous attention to detail. The heated front sport seats with leather seating surfaces provide exceptional comfort and support, while the S Line Interior Package elevates the cabin aesthetic with brushed aluminum inlays and stainless steel pedal caps. The power moonroof floods the cabin with natural light, creating an open and airy environment. Genuine wood accents throughout the dashboard, console, and door panels add warmth and sophistication to every surface.

Technology seamlessly integrates throughout the cabin to enhance both connectivity and convenience. The Audi Virtual Cockpit Plus delivers comprehensive vehicle information directly to your instrument cluster, while the Top View Camera System provides a complete perspective around your vehicle during parking and low-speed maneuvers. The Bang & Olufsen Sound System with 3D Sound transforms your audio experience with premium acoustics, and wireless phone charging keeps your devices powered throughout your journey.

Exterior refinement is evident in every element, from the aggressive styling of the BLACK OPTIC PLUS PACKAGE—featuring black Audi rings, black exterior trim, black mirror housings, and a black rear lip spoiler—to the striking 19" 5-Arm-Cutter Design Bi-Color wheels wrapped in all-season rubber. Red brake calipers add a dynamic accent, while dark chrome exhaust tips and black fender badges complete the commanding presence. Audi Beam-Rings welcome you with illuminated door trim that displays the iconic four rings.

Safety and security are paramount, with comprehensive features including an Alarm System with Motion Sensors, dual front impact airbags, side impact airbags, knee airbags, overhead airbags, and occupant sensing technology. Electronic Stability Control, Anti-lock Brakes, and four-wheel independent suspension work together to maintain composure in all driving scenarios. Audi Side Assist with Pre Sense Rear provides additional peace of mind, monitoring blind spots and nearby traffic.

This 2024 Audi A5 Sportback represents an exceptional value in the premium compact sports sedan segment, offering a harmonious blend of performance, luxury, and advanced technology. We invite you to experience this vehicle firsthand at our showroom, where our team stands ready to answer your questions and facilitate a test drive that showcases everything this exceptional automobile has to offer.

This white exterior sits on 18" two-tone machined alloy wheels that balance style with durability. description:
This 2022 Volkswagen Golf GTI Autobahn represents a refined entry into performance driving, combining everyday practicality with purposeful engineering designed to deliver satisfaction on both commutes and spirited drives.

- 2.0L TSI DOHC engine with 6-speed manual transmission
- MIB3 Discover Pro with 10" touchscreen navigation system
- Heads-Up Display
- Panoramic power moonroof
- Harman/Kardon premium audio system with 9 speakers and SiriusXM 360L
- Heated and ventilated front seats with perforated Vienna leather
- Heated rear seats and heated steering wheel
- Power driver and passenger seats with memory function
- 19" machined alloy wheels
- Automatic high-beam headlights with front fog lights
- All-wheel independent suspension with adaptive damping
- Active Blind Spot Monitor with autonomous emergency braking
- Rear parking camera
- Dual-zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Remote keyless entry with illuminated entry

The cabin welcomes you with purpose-built comfort and connectivity. Settle into the heated leather sport seats that adjust with power and memory, and you'll find the driving position refined through performance-focused design. The 10-inch navigation touchscreen keeps you oriented, while the Harman/Kardon audio system transforms routine journeys into something more engaging. Heated rear seats and a heated steering wheel ensure passenger comfort across seasons, and dual-zone automatic climate control maintains individual preferences effortlessly.

The mechanical foundation speaks to focused engineering. The 2.0L TSI engine pairs with a 6-speed manual transmission, delivering a direct connection between driver input and vehicle response. Four-wheel independent suspension with adaptive technology balances ride composure with cornering capability. Speed-sensing steering adjusts effort proportionally, while the comprehensive brake system and electronic stability control form a capable safety net—not something you'll think about until you need it.

Visibility and awareness come standard. Automatic high-beam headlights with front fog lights illuminate the road ahead, rain-sensing wipers keep the windshield clear, and the rear parking camera provides essential perspective when maneuvering. The Active Blind Spot Monitor quietly watches what you cannot see, while the forward collision warning system with autonomous emergency braking adds another layer of situational assurance.

The exterior presents a clean, purposeful stance. Finished in blue with 19-inch machined alloy wheels, this Golf GTI carries the understated confidence of a vehicle that doesn't need to announce itself. The panoramic moonroof expands the sense of space overhead, while body-color bumpers and a discrete spoiler maintain cohesion throughout the design.

With 54,390 miles on the odometer, this Golf GTI remains fresh within its production year. The combination of manual engagement, proven mechanical systems, and thoughtful amenities creates a vehicle that rewards attentive driving while remaining accessible for everyday use. This is an opportunity to own a performance-minded compact car that prioritizes driver involvement without sacrificing practicality or comfort.

2022 Audi S5 Safety and Security Features

The regenerative braking system enhances efficiency, and four-wheel ABS ensures stable braking performance. Interior motion sensors and anti-tow sensors bolster security, making this vehicle a safe choice for daily use.

Compatibility with the myAudi app and Audi connect allows remote control and vehicle monitoring, while the 10.1-inch infotainment screen offers easy access to navigation, music, and settings. Hands-free voice-operated phone calls and radio, including HD radio, keep you connected and entertained. The system includes nine speakers with a dedicated subwoofer, a touch screen display, and electronic messaging assistance with read and voice functions, ensuring a connected driving experience.

2022 Audi S5 Performance Features

Performance is at the core of this Audi S5, featuring auto start/stop technology to improve fuel efficiency. Its sport-tuned suspension offers precise handling and a dynamic driving experience. The full-time AWD system ensures optimal traction and stability in various road conditions, making it a versatile choice for drivers who value performance and reliability. Whether navigating city streets or open highways, this vehicle delivers a confident, exhilarating ride.

description:
The 2020 Honda Civic Sport is a stylish and fun-to-drive compact sedan that combines sporty design, excellent fuel efficiency, advanced technology, and Honda's legendary reliability. Built to deliver an engaging driving experience while maintaining everyday comfort and practicality, the Civic Sport remains one of the most popular and dependable compact cars on the market.

Powered by a 2.0 liter i-VTEC four-cylinder engine producing 158 horsepower and 138 lb-ft of torque, the Civic Sport delivers responsive performance and outstanding efficiency. The engine is paired with a smooth Continuously Variable Transmission (CVT) with paddle shifters, while a six-speed manual transmission was also available for driving enthusiasts. The front-wheel-drive platform provides confident handling, responsive steering, and a comfortable ride that makes every commute enjoyable.

The exterior features aggressive sport styling with a gloss black front grille, body-colored rear decklid spoiler, center-mounted chrome exhaust outlet, LED daytime running lights, bold body lines, and stylish 18-inch alloy wheels. Its athletic stance and modern design give the Civic Sport a premium appearance that stands out from other compact sedans.

Inside, the Civic Sport offers a spacious, driver-focused cabin with seating for five passengers. Premium sport cloth seats, a leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob, automatic climate control, push-button start, a 60/40 split-folding rear seat, and a spacious trunk provide outstanding comfort and versatility for everyday driving.

Technology is another major highlight. The 2020 Civic Sport comes equipped with a 7-inch Display Audio touchscreen, Apple CarPlay, Android Auto, Bluetooth HandsFreeLink, Bluetooth audio streaming, USB ports, voice recognition, SiriusXM capability, and an eight-speaker audio system. Steering wheel-mounted controls and a customizable digital instrument display keep important information easily accessible while driving.

The Civic Sport is known for its excellent driving dynamics. Its well-tuned suspension, precise steering, and rigid chassis provide agile handling while maintaining a smooth and comfortable ride. The combination of responsive performance and impressive fuel economy makes it an ideal vehicle for both city driving and long highway trips.

Safety is one of the Civic's greatest strengths. Every 2020 Honda Civic Sport comes standard with Honda Sensing®, which includes Collision Mitigation Braking System, Road Departure Mitigation System, Adaptive Cruise Control, Lane Keeping Assist System, Forward Collision Warning, Lane Departure Warning, and Traffic Sign Recognition. Additional safety features include a multi-angle rearview camera, Vehicle Stability Assist, Anti-Lock Braking System, Brake Assist, Tire Pressure Monitoring System, and multiple airbags.

Owners consistently praise the 2020 Honda Civic Sport for its outstanding reliability, sporty styling, comfortable interior, excellent fuel economy, advanced safety features, and low cost of ownership. Its combination of efficiency, practicality, and engaging performance continues to make it one of the top choices in the compact sedan segment.

The 2020 Honda Civic Sport is the perfect sedan for someone looking for sporty styling, dependable performance, advanced technology, exceptional fuel economy, and legendary Honda reliability in one complete package. Comfortable, efficient, fun to drive, and built to provide years of dependable ownership, this Civic Sport is ready for every journey ahead.

The exterior reflects the Sport trim's purposeful design with body-color bumpers, a rear spoiler, and those distinctive 18-inch alloy wheels. The rear window wiper handles precipitation when you need it, and the parking camera displays what's behind you on the infotainment screen when reversing.

This Civic is ready to serve you with proven reliability and the features you'll actually use. We invite you to schedule a test drive and discover how this vehicle meets your transportation needs.

The 2018 Toyota Prius Four is a highly efficient and well equipped hybrid hatchback that combines exceptional fuel economy, proven Toyota reliability, advanced technology, and impressive everyday practicality. The Four is one of the higher trim levels in the 2018 Prius lineup, adding premium comfort and convenience features to Toyota's renowned hybrid platform.

Powered by Toyota's 1.8 liter four cylinder hybrid powertrain, the Prius produces a combined 121 horsepower through Toyota's Hybrid Synergy Drive system. An electronically controlled continuously variable transmission provides smooth acceleration, while regenerative braking helps recover energy and improve efficiency.

Fuel economy is one of the Prius's biggest strengths. The 2018 Prius Four is rated at approximately 54 MPG city and 50 MPG highway, depending on configuration, making it an outstanding choice for commuters and drivers looking to minimize fuel costs.

The exterior features the Prius's distinctive aerodynamic design with LED headlights, LED daytime running lights, LED taillights, fog lights, heated power mirrors, rear spoiler, and 15 inch alloy wheels. The aerodynamic body helps improve efficiency while giving the Prius its instantly recognizable appearance.

Inside, the Prius Four offers a comfortable and modern cabin with seating for five passengers. Features include SofTex trimmed seating, heated front seats, an eight way power adjustable driver's seat, leather wrapped steering wheel, dual zone automatic climate control, Smart Key System with push button start, and premium interior accents.

The Prius provides excellent cargo versatility thanks to its hatchback design. The 60/40 split folding rear seats allow the cargo area to expand substantially when needed, making it easy to carry groceries, luggage, sports equipment, camping gear, and everyday cargo.

Technology is a major highlight of the Prius Four. Features include a large 11.6 inch touchscreen display, navigation, Bluetooth connectivity, USB connectivity, SiriusXM, voice recognition, and smartphone integration depending on equipment. A premium JBL audio system provides an upgraded listening experience.

The Prius delivers an exceptionally smooth and quiet driving experience. Its hybrid system can operate on electric power during certain low speed conditions, while regenerative braking helps capture energy that would otherwise be lost. The low center of gravity and responsive steering provide confident handling while maintaining a comfortable ride.

Safety is another major strength. The 2018 Prius comes standard with Toyota Safety Sense P, including Pre Collision System with Pedestrian Detection, Lane Departure Alert with Steering Assist, Automatic High Beams, and Dynamic Radar Cruise Control. Additional safety features include a rearview camera, Vehicle Stability Control, Traction Control, Anti Lock Braking System, Brake Assist, Tire Pressure Monitoring System, and multiple airbags.

The Prius Four also offers excellent visibility and everyday convenience. Its hatchback design, compact exterior dimensions, and efficient hybrid powertrain make it particularly well suited for city driving and commuting.

Owners appreciate the 2018 Toyota Prius Four for its exceptional fuel economy, reliable hybrid technology, spacious hatchback design, advanced safety features, comfortable interior, and low operating costs. It provides one of the most efficient and practical transportation packages in its class.

The 2018 Toyota Prius Four is the perfect vehicle for someone looking for exceptional fuel economy, premium comfort, advanced technology, proven Toyota hybrid reliability, spacious cargo capacity, and everyday practicality in one complete package. Efficient, dependable, comfortable, and incredibly economical to drive, this Prius Four is ready for commuting, road trips, and everyday life.

This 2018 Buick Regal Preferred delivers a refined driving experience with a turbocharged engine and modern conveniences designed for today's driver.

- LED headlamps with auto leveling
- Cornering lamps
- Rear Park Assist with ultrasonic sensors
- Rear Cross Traffic Alert
- Lane Change Alert with Side Blind Zone Alert
- Buick Infotainment System with Navigation and 8" color touch screen
- Bose premium 8-speaker audio system
- Remote Vehicle Starter System
- 8-way power driver seat with lumbar control
- 18" alloy wheels with 245/45R18 tires
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Auto-dimming rear-view mirror
- Four-wheel independent suspension
- Four-wheel disc ABS brakes

The turbocharged 2.0L four-cylinder engine pairs with a nine-speed automatic transmission, offering 22 city MPG and 32 highway MPG for balanced efficiency and performance. The front-wheel drive platform ensures confident handling and stability in various driving conditions.

Safety and awareness define this Regal's design. Dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and rear side impact airbags provide comprehensive protection. The comprehensive sensor suite includes rear parking assist, rear cross-traffic alert, and lane change alert to help you navigate confidently.

Inside, you'll find an 8-way power driver seat with 2-way power lumbar adjustment for personalized comfort during your daily drives. The cabin features front bucket seats with cloth trim, and a split-folding rear seat offers versatility for cargo needs. The Buick Infotainment System with navigation provides intuitive control at your fingertips alongside the eight-speaker Bose premium audio system.

This gray Regal presents well with its 18-inch alloy wheels and modern exterior styling. Power windows, power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, heated door mirrors, and fully automatic LED headlamps with cornering lamps enhance both function and appearance. The front license plate bracket completes the professional look.

The vehicle is equipped with essential comfort and convenience features including dual-zone air conditioning, telescoping steering wheel, speed control, electronic stability control, and traction control for secure driving in multiple environments.

The bright yellow exterior gives this Fit a distinctive presence on the road while maintaining the practical appeal that makes this model popular with families and commuters alike. The power moonroof adds openness to the driving experience, and the backup camera provides helpful visibility when reversing.

Safety and visibility have been thoughtfully equipped. Dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, and overhead airbags work with the electronic stability control system. Automatic headlights adjust to changing light conditions, and front fog lights enhance visibility during adverse weather. The rear window wiper and intermittent wipers maintain clear sightlines.

Inside, the A7 provides a thoughtfully appointed cabin that balances comfort with modern convenience. The leather seating surfaces include heated front seats for cold mornings, while the heated steering wheel and heated rear seats enhance passenger comfort regardless of season. The exterior parking camera rear assists with precision when backing, while the security system and panic alarm protect the vehicle. Speed control and speed-sensing steering round out a comprehensive driver assistance package.

Additional refinements include genuine wood trim on the dashboard, door panels, and console, creating an upscale interior atmosphere. The power driver seat adjusts to multiple positions for optimal comfort, while the split folding rear seat expands versatility for cargo needs. Safety and Security
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
Technology and Telematics
  • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. Safety has been prioritized throughout this vehicle's design and equipment. Multiple airbag systems—including dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee airbags, and overhead airbags—work alongside electronic stability control, traction control, ABS brakes, and brake assist. Discover the exceptional efficiency and reliability of this 2024 Nissan Leaf S, a vehicle that combines practical electric driving with thoughtful design to meet the needs of today's conscious driver.

The silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that suits any setting. Inside, the cabin features comfortable cloth seating with front bucket seats and a front center armrest, designed to keep you relaxed during daily commutes and weekend drives. The split folding rear seat provides flexibility for passengers or cargo, while the overall layout maximizes interior practicality.

This Leaf S delivers impressive efficiency that makes every charge count. With an estimated 123 MPGe in city driving and 99 MPGe on the highway, your cost per mile drops significantly compared to traditional fuel vehicles. The electric motor paired with a single-speed reducer offers smooth, responsive acceleration without the complexity of traditional transmissions, making your drive straightforward and enjoyable.

Safety is paramount with dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags positioned throughout the cabin. The anti-lock braking system, electronic stability control, and traction control work together to help maintain grip and control. Rear parking sensors assist with maneuvering in tight spaces, while the security system and panic alarm provide additional peace of mind.

Technology seamlessly integrates into your daily routine through NissanConnect, which connects to your smartphone via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The AM/FM radio with SiriusXM satellite service keeps you entertained, and Siri Eyes Free allows voice control while keeping your hands on the wheel. Steering wheel mounted audio controls let you manage functions without looking away from the road.

Practical features throughout the vehicle demonstrate attention to detail. Telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjustment accommodates different driver preferences, while the trip computer tracks your driving efficiency. Illuminated entry, overhead console, and vanity mirrors enhance convenience, and the included floor mats and cargo area mat protect your investment from daily wear.

This 2024 Nissan Leaf S represents an intelligent choice for drivers seeking efficiency, safety, and dependable performance. We invite you to visit and experience the value this vehicle offers firsthand.
